title: GAMBLING | The House Always Wins
description:
Every night, a kind voice told him one more bet would win it all back. Every night, the thing dealing the cards got a little closer.

GAMBLING | The House Always Wins is an animated short film about the habit that bets everything you love in the dark, and the morning he finally walked away from the table.

Have you ever chased a loss you couldn't afford? Tell me in the comments.

#shortfilm #animation #horror #selfimprovement #gamblingaddiction
